title: Dollar-Up Calculator
description: Practise selecting the whole-dollar amount needed to pay for an item in Singapore dollars.
learningObjective: Identify the smallest whole-dollar amount that covers a stated price.
suggestedUse: Use with a pretend shop or picture menu; introduce real coins and notes alongside the screen.
adaptations: Reduce the number of answer options.
Pair each price with physical play money.
Add familiar school-canteen items and prices.

title: Communication Choice Board
description: Build a simple request by selecting labelled symbols and phrases.
learningObjective: Make a choice and communicate a basic want or need.
suggestedUse: Model functional requests during short routines, with access to the learner’s existing AAC system.
adaptations: Replace examples with personalised, familiar vocabulary.
Adjust the number of choices displayed.
Use photographs or agreed AAC symbols with appropriate licensing.

title: Five-Star Token Board
description: A teacher-controlled visual board for adding, removing and resetting five tokens.
learningObjective: Understand progress towards an agreed positive reinforcement goal.
suggestedUse: Agree on an achievable target and meaningful reinforcement with the learner before use.
adaptations: Change the number of tokens to match the learner’s needs.
Use personalised reinforcement choices.
Pair with explicit instructions and immediate feedback.

title: My Visual Schedule
description: Follow a short routine, mark steps as done and change their order.
learningObjective: Recognise the next activity and track completion of a familiar sequence.
suggestedUse: Preview the routine, then support transitions using objects, photographs or familiar cues.
adaptations: Replace the example routine with the learner’s real routine.

Pair words with individualised photographs.

title: Workplace Sorting Practice
description: Select workplace objects and sort them into the correct storage areas.
learningObjective: Match common workplace items to their designated storage categories.
suggestedUse: Practise onscreen first and transfer to an actual classroom or simulated work area.

Add workplace labels and a physical sorting task.

title: Colour Pattern Maker
description: Create and check simple repeating patterns using labelled colour tiles.
learningObjective: Extend and reproduce repeating AB, AAB and ABC patterns.
suggestedUse: Use with coloured manipulatives before completing a digital pattern.
adaptations: Use only two choices to start.

description: Choose movement cues, assemble a short sequence and play it back with optional sounds.
learningObjective: Follow and imitate a simple sequence of movement prompts.
suggestedUse: Teacher models safe, learner-appropriate movements, then explores simple sequences.
adaptations: Offer seated movement alternatives.

title: Visual Focus Timer
description: A large, adjustable countdown with pause, resume, reset and visual progress.
learningObjective: Use a predictable visual cue to anticipate the end of a short activity.
suggestedUse: Introduce the timer gently and use it only when it supports the learner’s comfort and understanding.
